title: The Last Inheritance Again
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Noor Voss, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
